cues.zh: 點開後，有 debug.log 與 error.log。

cues.en: So if you open the debug log you're going to see that all the logs that have a log level of info debug up to warning have been added to this file.
cues.zh: 開啟 debug.log，會看到 INFO、DEBUG 到 WARNING 的日誌都寫入這個檔案。

cues.en: The error and the critical logs were not included here, meaning that the filter worked.
cues.zh: ERROR 與 CRITICAL 沒有寫進來，表示篩選條件有效。

cues.en: You remember the filter that we had defined up here for the debug log handler?
cues.zh: 記得上面為除錯日誌處理常式定義的 filter 嗎？

cues.en: We had set up this filter to include the error logs that are less than or equal to the warning log level, which is info debug and warning.
cues.zh: 它會包含等級小於或等於 WARNING 的日誌，也就是 INFO、DEBUG 與 WARNING。

cues.en: And you're also going to realize that the logs are well formatted.
cues.zh: 也會注意到，日誌格式很整齊。

cues.en: We have the timestamp, then the log level, then the function causing the log message and the log message.
cues.zh: 有時間戳記、日誌等級、發出日誌的函式，以及訊息。

cues.en: Remember we had set up the format right here with time level name message and the function and the line that you can see here we have the name function and the line causing the error and the message itself.
cues.zh: 記得，這裡設定的格式有 time、level、name、message、function 與 line。可以看到模組、函式、發生錯誤的行號與訊息本身。

cues.en: So our formatting is working correctly.
cues.zh: 所以格式設定正常運作。

cues.en: And now if you open the error log you're also going to see that only the error and the critical logs were added to this file and no other logs.
cues.zh: 再開啟 error.log，就會看到只有 ERROR 與 CRITICAL，沒有其他等級。

cues.en: And this is because of the way we had set up error log handler.
cues.zh: 這是因為錯誤日誌處理常式的設定方式。

cues.en: And you're also going to see that the error logs are well formatted with the timestamp, then the log level, then the function causing the error and the log message.
cues.zh: 錯誤日誌的格式同樣整齊，包含時間戳記、日誌等級、發生錯誤的函式與訊息。

cues.en: So as you can see, setting up log guru is quite simple, so feel free to customize this login functionality how you wish.
cues.zh: Loguru 的設定相當簡單，你可以依照需要自訂日誌記錄功能。

cues.en: But as for me, I shall leave it like this.
cues.zh: 我會先保持這樣。

cues.en: Then remember, it's not a good practice to add your logs to git.
cues.zh: 記得，把日誌加入 Git 並不是好的做法。

cues.en: As you can see, our logs are already added to the gitignore file and that's why they have been grayed out.
cues.zh: 日誌已被 .gitignore 忽略，所以顯示為灰色。

cues.en: And now that we've tested this logging functionality we're going to go to the back end app directory.
cues.zh: 測試完日誌功能後，到 backend/app 目錄，

cues.en: And we're going to delete this logs directory.
cues.zh: 刪除這個 logs 目錄。

cues.en: Because in the next lecture we're going to be setting up this logs directory to be created automatically in our host machine and on our Docker container when we are building our containers.
cues.zh: 因為下一堂課會設定，在建置容器時，自動於主機與 Docker 容器建立 logs 目錄。

cues.en: This was just to test things out to make sure that the logs are actually created in the right location.
cues.zh: 這裡只是測試，確認日誌確實建立在正確位置。

cues.en: So just right click on that, then delete that directory.
cues.zh: 按右鍵，再刪除該目錄。

cues.en: Then go back to the terminal.
cues.zh: 回到終端機。

cues.en: Then you can stop the running server with Ctrl C and go back to VS code.
cues.zh: 按 Ctrl+C 停止伺服器，再回到 VS Code。

cues.en: Then we can make a commit.
cues.zh: 接著提交。

cues.en: And this is a feature.
cues.zh: 這是一次 feat，

cues.en: And you can say add logging with Log Guru like that.
cues.zh: 訊息可以是 add logging with Loguru。

cues.en: Then we can make the commit good.
cues.zh: 再提交，很好。

cues.en: That's basically for this lecture.
cues.zh: 這堂課基本上就到這裡。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一堂課見。
